The City Council meetings of July 20 through August 18 of 2026 have been adjourned, pursuant to the 2026 Legislative Calendar adopted by Resolution 316464 on October 21, 2025.
The next regularly scheduled meeting of the City Council is Monday, August 24, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., and Tuesday, August 25, 2026, at 10:00 a.m.
